lead.titleZh: 慢性下腰痛跑步干预，多发性硬化症跌倒预测，颈髓损伤下肢功能恢复轨迹
lead.titleEn: Running intervention for chronic LBP, MS fall prediction, SCI lower limb function recovery
lead.paragraphZh: 今日共 6 条信号，涵盖 4 个专业方向，其中 3 项观察研究得分均达 75 分，分别关注慢性下腰痛的跑步干预设计、多发性硬化症老年患者跌倒预测以及颈髓损伤后下肢运动功能恢复轨迹。另有一项儿童康复综述，针对高收入国家社会经济弱势地区儿童校内体育活动推广项目，值得参考。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's 6 signals span 4 specialties, with three observational studies all scoring 75 points, focusing on running intervention design for chronic low back pain, fall prediction in older adults with multiple sclerosis, and lower limb motor function recovery trajectories after cervical spinal cord injury. Additionally, a pediatric rehabilitation review on school-based physical activity promotion programs for children in socio-economically disadvantaged contexts in high-income countries is noteworthy.

items.title: Designing a novel running intervention for adults with chronic low back pain (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: A PhD thesis aimed to design and evaluate a novel running intervention for adults with chronic low back pain (LBP) to achieve clinically meaningful reductions in pain intensity and disability, also exploring beliefs about running safety as a barrier.
items.curatedReason: 这项博士研究正在探索跑步对慢性下腰痛（LBP）患者的干预效果。初步结果可能提示跑步是一种可行的 LBP 管理方案，但请注意，在推荐跑步前，你应充分评估患者对跑步安全性的顾虑及个体情况。
items.titleZh: 为慢性下腰痛成人设计一种新型跑步干预（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 一项博士论文旨在设计并评估一种针对慢性下腰痛（LBP）成人患者的新型跑步干预措施，以实现疼痛强度和残疾的临床显著改善，并探讨了对跑步安全性的信念是否构成参与障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD research is exploring the effects of running as an intervention for adults with chronic low back pain (LBP). Initial findings may suggest running is a viable LBP management option, but before recommending it, you should thoroughly assess patients' beliefs about running safety and their individual circumstances.
items.limitation: 研究设计仅为单一干预方案的设计与评估，缺乏与无治疗对照组的比较数据。
items.limitationEn: The study design is limited to the design and evaluation of a single intervention, lacking comparative data with a no-treatment control group.

items.title: Associations of Patient-Reported and Objective Measures of Mobility With Prospective Falls in Older Adults with Multiple Sclerosis
items.summary: This study evaluated associations between the patient determined disease steps (PDDS) scale and the short physical performance battery (SPPB) with prospective falls in older adults with multiple sclerosis (OAMS), aiming to address a gap in the literature.
items.curatedReason: 对于多发性硬化症老年患者的跌倒风险评估，本研究提示患者自评的疾病分级量表（PDDS）和客观的短期体能表现电池（SPPB）均有参考价值。在临床实践中，你可以考虑结合两者，进行更全面的跌倒风险预测与干预。
items.titleZh: 多发性硬化症老年患者自评和客观移动能力测量与未来跌倒的关联
items.summaryZh: 本研究旨在评估患者自评疾病分级量表（PDDS）和短期体能表现电池（SPPB）与多发性硬化症（MS）老年患者未来跌倒之间的关联，以填补文献空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: For fall risk assessment in older adults with multiple sclerosis, this study suggests both the patient-determined disease steps (PDDS) scale and the objective short physical performance battery (SPPB) are valuable. In clinical practice, you might consider combining both for a more comprehensive fall risk prediction and intervention.
items.limitation: 研究未报告具体的样本量和统计结果，限制了对结论强度的判断。
items.limitationEn: The study did not report specific sample size or statistical results, limiting the ability to judge the strength of the conclusions.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Recovery Trajectories of Lower Limb Motor Function After Cervical Spinal Cord Injury: A Latent Class Mixed Model Analysis
items.summary: This study employed a latent class mixed model analysis to investigate the recovery trajectories of lower limb motor function following cervical spinal cord injury, aiming to inform treatment strategies and rehabilitation programs.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究利用潜在类别混合模型分析了颈髓损伤后下肢运动功能的恢复轨迹，它能帮助您更好地理解患者在不同阶段的功能变化，从而更精准地制定康复计划。
items.titleZh: 颈髓损伤后下肢运动功能恢复轨迹：潜在类别混合模型分析
items.summaryZh: 本研究采用潜在类别混合模型分析法，探讨了颈髓损伤后下肢运动功能的恢复轨迹，旨在为治疗策略和康复计划的制定提供依据。
items.curatedReasonEn: Lower limb motor function recovery after cervical spinal cord injury is not monolithic; this study, using latent class mixed model analysis, identified distinct recovery trajectories. This implies that when developing rehabilitation plans, you should individualize them, optimizing intervention strategies based on the patient's specific recovery pattern.
items.limitation: 摘要未提供研究设计细节、样本量和具体的恢复轨迹数据，限制了对结论的全面理解。
items.limitationEn: The abstract lacks details on study design, sample size, and specific recovery trajectory data, limiting a comprehensive understanding of the conclusions.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Faith, culture and physical activity: addressing participation barriers in UK Muslim communities
items.summary: This article explores the faith and cultural barriers impacting physical activity participation within UK Muslim communities, highlighting lower reported physical activity levels despite diverse backgrounds and demographics.
items.curatedReason: 英国穆斯林社区的体育活动参与度较低，这可能与信仰和文化障碍有关。设计运动干预策略时，你应充分考虑这些因素，才能确保方案的文化适宜性和有效性。
items.titleZh: 信仰、文化与体育活动：解决英国穆斯林社区的参与障碍
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了影响英国穆斯林社区体育活动参与的信仰和文化障碍，强调尽管背景和人口结构多样，但该群体报告的体育活动水平普遍较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: Lower physical activity levels in UK Muslim communities may stem from faith and cultural barriers. When designing exercise interventions, you must thoroughly consider these factors to ensure cultural appropriateness and effectiveness.

items.title: International school-based physical activity promotion programmes for children in socio-economically disadvantaged contexts in high-income countries: a narrative review and structured analysis
items.summary: A narrative review and structured analysis identified that school-based physical activity interventions in socio-economically disadvantaged contexts in high-income countries benefit from hybrid implementation models and highly adapted programs, ensuring contextual fit and local ownership.
items.curatedReason: 在高收入国家社会经济弱势地区推行校内体育活动，成功的关键在于采用混合实施模式和高度本地化的项目。这意味着你必须深入社区，确保干预措施与当地语境高度契合，并激发当地居民的自主性。
items.titleZh: 高收入国家社会经济弱势地区儿童校内体育活动推广项目：叙述性综述与结构分析
items.summaryZh: 一项叙述性综述与结构分析发现，在高收入国家社会经济弱势地区，校内体育活动干预项目若采用混合实施模式和高度适应性方案，能更好地实现情境契合和本地所有权。
items.curatedReasonEn: For school-based physical activity interventions in socio-economically disadvantaged contexts in high-income countries, success hinges on hybrid implementation models and highly adapted programs. This means you must engage deeply with communities to ensure interventions are contextually tailored and foster local ownership.
items.limitation: 该综述的实施条件合成仅限于研究明确报告的信息，可能存在信息遗漏。
items.limitationEn: The synthesis of implementation conditions in this review was limited to explicitly reported information, potentially leading to omissions.

items.title: Physical activity interventions for promoting 24-hour movement behaviours, physical fitness, fundamental movement skills and cognitive function in Chinese preschoolers (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: A doctoral research project explored physical activity and eHealth interventions to improve 24-hour movement behaviors, physical fitness, fundamental movement skills, and cognitive function in Chinese preschoolers, combining evidence syntheses with real-world, culturally tailored programs.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，在改善中国学龄前儿童的 24 小时运动行为和认知功能方面，结合证据综合与文化适宜的 eHealth 干预可能有效。这为你将理论与数字技术应用于早期儿童健康促进提供了思路。
items.titleZh: 体育活动干预对中国学龄前儿童24小时运动行为、体能、基本运动技能和认知功能的影响（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 一项博士研究项目探讨了体育活动和电子健康干预如何改善中国学龄前儿童的 24 小时运动行为、体能、基本运动技能和认知功能，结合证据合成与现实世界中、文化适宜的干预方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD research focuses on 24-hour movement behaviors and cognitive function interventions for Chinese preschoolers. It can help you understand how to integrate theory and digital technology to provide culturally tailored solutions for early childhood health promotion.
